chunks.arabic_text: وَ سَأَلَ عُبَيْدُ بْنُ زُرَارَةَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: And ʿUbayd ibn Zurarah asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الْغَدَاةَ رَكْعَةً وَ يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ وَ يَذْهَبُ وَ يَجِيءُ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا صَلَّى رَكْعَةً

translations.en: About a man who performs the Fajr prayer as one rakʿah, then recites the tashahhud, departs, goes away and comes back, then remembers that he had only prayed one rakʿah.
He عليه السلام said: "He adds another rakʿah to it."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in salat (prayer), specifically in the Fajr prayer. If a person finishes after one rakʿah and later remembers the omission, the Imam عليه السلام rules that he should add one more rakʿah to complete the prayer.
en.seo_question: What should someone do if he remembers after finishing Fajr that he prayed only one rakʿah?

key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he concludes and turns away from the prayer
key_terms.إِلَيْهَا: to it, meaning to the prayer already performed
